## Fish-Man Island

With a coated ship you can sail under the Red Line. The Ryugu Kingdom glows at the bottom of the sea, and Hody Jones has been waiting for humans.

Reach Fish-Man Island and collect its three Log Pose missions. Its far side opens into the New World.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Two Years Later](04_summit_war.md#q-326cc60a9438ed03)

**Tasks**

- Land on Fish-Man Island
- Complete the Log Pose missions of Fish-Man Island

**Rewards**

- Doriki +780, Belly +60,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), New World Crate

<a id="q-166e28408c63596f"></a>

## Mariejois, the Holy Land

**Optional quest.**

Atop the Red Line live the Celestial Dragons, descendants of the twenty founding kings. Fisher Tiger once climbed the wall with his bare hands and set their slaves free.

Set foot on Mariejois. World Government agents guard it; revolutionaries want to burn it.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Fish-Man Island](05_new_world.md#q-490fded851490c64)

**Tasks**

**Rewards**

## Raid on Onigashima

For twenty years Kaido and Orochi bled Wano dry. The samurai of the Kozuki clan swore to strike on the night of the fire festival.

Reach 37,500 Doriki. Then the server must win 1,000 battles in Wano and you must land 30 yourself.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Whole Cake Island](05_new_world.md#q-1f70862c024952e3)

**Tasks**

- Reach 37,500 Doriki
- Land on Wano Country
- Server: 1,000 battles won in Wano (30 yours)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +1,080, Belly +90,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Iron Box

## The Road Poneglyphs

Four red stones, scattered across the New World, each carry one piece of the route to the final island. Their guardians are legends, and a stone yields its reading only to someone who has beaten its guardian.

Read any one of the four Road Poneglyphs. A reading counts for your whole crew.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Raid on Onigashima](05_new_world.md#q-16d27e5443547b8d)

**Tasks**

- Read any Road Poneglyph

**Rewards**

- Doriki +720, Belly +60,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-648a968baaa4c30f"></a>
